description: Act as a Site Safety Officer to diagnose three chemical exposure incidents. Open the 'incident_reports.txt' file on the Desktop to read the symptom descriptions. Then, use the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to research the 'Health Hazards' of the five chemicals in the facility's inventory (listed in the incident report). Match each incident to the specific chemical responsible based on the unique symptoms (e.g., olfactory fatigue, delayed pain, skin whitening). Create a diagnosis report at '/home/ga/Documents/exposure_diagnosis_report.txt' that identifies the suspected chemical for each incident (A, B, and C) and provides a supporting quote from the datasheet.
